environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) in us-east-1. Pod runs in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway attached. The Kubernetes Service is type LoadBalancer (NLB) exposing both port 50051 (gRPC) and port 8080 (HTTP debug endpoint) to the internet. No NetworkPolicy applied. The API gateway (Envoy sidecar) proxies the gRPC HTML fragments directly into browser responses with Content-Type text/html. No CSP headers configured on the gateway.
